title: Druqks Tin Lament
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: A melancholic braindance piece that opens with a ghostly sawtooth melody floating alone before a stuttering 606 kick gradually builds the arrangement into a churning, multi-layered climax of filtered bass and echoing leads. The final section retreats to a sparse, heavily delayed fade — all warmth and dissolution.
